verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party guide says Postgres has built-in full-text search, "like a 'search engine' within Postgres." It documents `to_tsvector`/`to_tsquery`, match operators and search-column indexing that run directly against the project database, with no external search service. Every project being a full Postgres database backs this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of search in practice, and evidence of client-library/API exposure and relevance ranking at scale.
